# INERIM Interior
> Modern architectural interior design, turnkey execution, and precision modular manufacturing studio based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Overview
INERIM Interior synthesizes Japandi minimalism, Scandinavian warmth, and German industrial prefabrication to design and deliver luxury residential apartments, sky penthouses, and high-performance commercial headquarters. Handover is contractually completed within 45 working days with locked line-item pricing.

## Contractual Architectural Guarantees
- **45-Day Handover Guarantee:** All joinery is 75% pre-milled in an automated German CNC facility while civil and electrical works proceed in parallel on-site. If delivery exceeds 45 working days, INERIM pays a contractual credit penalty of ৳5,000 per delayed day.
- **100% Locked Itemized BOQ:** Every board thickness, hinge brand, and finish grade is priced before deposit. INERIM absorbs contractor-side price escalations.
- **Flat 2-Year Comprehensive Warranty:** Covers structural woodwork, Blum/Hettich drawer runners and hinges, lighting transformers, and anti-termite integrity with 48-hour emergency site support.
- **Dustless On-Site Fitting:** Cabinetry arrives pre-drilled for rapid, silent cam-lock installation, keeping dust and AC duct contamination minimal.

## Turnkey Pricing & Packages (Bangladesh)
- **Essential Living — ৳1,350 / sq.ft:** Moisture-resistant Action TESA HDHMR boards, machine-pressed 1mm PVC edge-banding, hydraulic soft-close hinges, Berger Luxury Silk emulsion, standard false ceiling with LED profiles. Best for 1,200–1,800 sq.ft apartments and rentals.
- **Signature Architectural — ৳1,950 / sq.ft (Most Popular):** Open-grain American Walnut and Oak veneers, Austrian Senosan 2mm acrylics, 100% German Blum runners and hinges, concealed 3000K warm circadian LED cove channels, marine ply Grade 710 kitchen carcasses. Best for 1,800–3,500 sq.ft luxury apartments.
- **Bespoke Ultra-Luxury — ৳2,850 / sq.ft:** Honed Italian Statuario marble inlays, PVD titanium champagne brass trims, radius curved timber joinery, smart home scene automation, European integrated kitchen appliances, tinted glass walk-in wardrobes. Best for 3,000+ sq.ft penthouses and villas.

## Custom Furniture & Modular Joinery Catalog
- **Floating King Bed with Ambient Cove Light:** Cantilevered steel-reinforced platform bed with 3000K circadian floor glow and integrated wireless charging docks.
- **Bespoke Acrylic U-Shaped Modular Kitchen:** Waterproof marine plywood carcass, 2mm Senosan scratch-resistant acrylic shutters, quartz countertops, Blum Tandembox drawers.
- **Architectural Louvre Wardrobe:** Tropical-modernist slatted timber doors allowing natural air circulation in humid conditions, fitted with automated sensor illumination.
- **Marble-Look Dining Suite:** Non-porous sintered porcelain stone tabletop heat-proof to 1200°C paired with champagne brass steel frame and ergonomic shell chairs.

## Key Projects & Case Studies
- **Mrs. Sinthia Chowdhury's Residence:** 3,850 sq.ft luxury duplex in Gulshan Diplomatic Zone. Warm Japandi minimalism, Italian Statuario marble dining island, delivered in 44 days.
- **Mr. Iftekhar's Grand Penthouse:** 4,500 sq.ft lakefront penthouse in Banani. Bespoke architectural cove ceilings, smoked glass partitions, delivered in 45 days.
- **Bettex Corporate Headquarters:** 6,200 sq.ft corporate headquarters with biophilic acoustics and agile collaboration forums, delivered in 43 days.

## Service Areas
Dhaka, Bangladesh — Gulshan, Banani, Baridhara Diplomatic Zone, Uttara, Dhanmondi, Bashundhara R/A, Mirpur DOHS, Mohakhali DOHS.
